newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest turnover slightly up, prices down.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest turnover slightly up, prices down.

text.p: Thin investor interest kept turnover on the Bucharest bourse low at 29.8 million lei, a scant 4.0 million up on the previous session.
Low demand also drove most prices down. Two stocks had no trade.
Azomures SA fertiliser maker remained in the limelight, taking 70 percent of turnover. It closed 100 lei higher at 11,100.
"This will probably be the picture for the rest of the year. Around 25 million lei in turnover levels and Azomures at centre-stage," said a broker.

Carbid-Fox SA chemical plant, the latest company to join the bourse, aroused some interest, trading 150 shares in eight transactions. It opened at 3,800 lei and closed 100 lei stronger. Carbid shares have a face value of 1,000 lei.
"We expected interest in Carbid as it is a company with healthy financial results," another broker said.
Carbid had a 10-month gross profit of 6.6 billion lei this year, compared with 7.4 billion lei in 1995. Last year, it paid a 4,000 lei dividend per share, among the highest in Romania.

Syringe maker Sanevit SA remained suspended for the sixth session in a row pending an announcement. Traders said they expected heavy trading in its shares when it returns to the market as many buy and sell orders have amassed.

Two unofficial value-weighted indices - the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA, and Bucharest Investment Group 's BIG -- fell from the previous session. The VAB fell 0.2 percent to 293.9 points and the BIG slipped 0.17 percent to 293.04 points.
The VAB said an index value of 285.1 percent for the previous session had been revised to 294.3 points.
